newsitem.title: USA: Physician Reliance named in class action.
newsitem.headline: Physician Reliance named in class action.

text.p: A class action suit has been filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas on behalf of purchasers of the common stock of Physician Reliance Network Inc between Feb. 12 and July 11, 1996, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Wednesday.

The complaint charges Physician Reliance, certain of its officers and directors and Texas Oncology P.A. with violations of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 by, among other things, misrepresenting and/or omitting information about the company's relationship with Texas Oncology and its billing practices.

The complaint alleges the defendants engaged in a series of convoluted transactions between the company and Texas Oncology, among others and these unusual transactions deceptively overstated the company's financial condition.
By issuing a series of false and misleading statements, the price of Physician Reliance stock was artificially inflated, the plaintiffs charge.
No one from Physician Reliance was available to comment on the suit.
Early on Wednesday evening, Physician Reliance Chief Executive Merrick Reese, in a telephone interview, said the suit is without merit and the company will vigorously defend itself.
